$comment: Ground truth for the react pack (docs/packs.md, "Ground truth"). Each public repository is pinned at the commit before its own React 18 to 19 upgrade. Expected findings come from two sources that are not Uptide, drafted by pnpm packs:truth and read by hand: the diagnostics the repository's TypeScript reports with react, react-dom, @types/react and @types/react-dom at the upgrade's versions linked in and not without them (errors and deprecations), and the lines the upgrade commit changed for react (one site per construct). Left out on purpose: comment-only and insertion-only lines, imports that follow a site, changes for other packages (vitest, testing-library, TypeScript target types, setTimeout typings), tldraw's casts of spread menu-item props and docs code.tsx lines that stayed valid, and excalidraw's forwardRef to ref-prop rewrite of DebugCanvas, which React 19 does not require. Rules are assigned from each site's code and text; the many JSX diagnostics that follow from the missing global JSX namespace share one rule.

repos.why: Excalidraw: a React 18 canvas editor with a library package, an app and tests; forwardRef components, RefObject props, global JSX types and ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode in tests
tldraw: a React 18 SDK monorepo with an app, docs and templates; RefObject hooks, useRef without an argument, element.props typed unknown, JSX types
